content: A day of bitter sorrow feels like a century, but a day of shared love passes like a heartbeat.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
explanation: Time is elastic: when our hearts are heavy with grief or fear, every tick of the clock drags like an iron weight. But when sitting with those we love in laughter and fellowship, hours melt away in an instant. Treasure the fleeting sweetness of loving company.
practicalInsight: Savor every minute with your family or friends tonight. Don't let your attention wander away from the sacred hour.
reflectionPrompt: When was the last time you were so fully present in love that hours felt like a single heartbeat?
